explanation: Pooled p = 1,060 / 20,000 = 0.053. SE = sqrt(0.053 × 0.947 × (1/10,000 + 1/10,000)) = sqrt(0.0000100382) = 0.0031683. The difference is 0.056 - 0.050 = 0.006, so z = 0.006 / 0.0031683 = 1.894, which rounds to 1.89. Using the difference in percentage points, 0.6, instead of the proportion 0.006 would make z 100 times too large.
